[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Concert tickets** [CSES 1091 · Concert Tickets](https://cses.fi/problemset/task/1091)

Each query is "predecessor of $t$" in a set that loses elements. In C++ that is one `multiset` call. In Python, sort the prices once; a ticket at sorted position $j$ is either free or taken, and we want the largest free position $\le$ `bisect_right(h, t)`. A **union–find that points each taken position to the one on its left** jumps over taken tickets in near-constant amortized time.

[Solved in full in @sec-lang-p4-tickets.]{.card-link}

:::
